title: Cloud Storage and Distributed File Systems
file: Lesson 07 - Cloud Storage and Distributed File Systems.html
src: Source: Lecture 07 Cloud Storage and Distributed File Systems (28 slides); also covers Assignment 01 Part B.
lead: Lecture 07: why storage is distributed, block vs file vs object storage, Google File System (architecture, read path, relaxed consistency, limits), HDFS (NameNode / DataNode, HA, rack awareness, erasure coding, small-file problem), GFS vs HDFS, Amazon S3 (buckets, keys, 11 nines, storage classes, strong consistency, security), EBS, EFS, the AWS storage ecosystem and the four DFS design trade-offs.
